what: The hero is covered with a 72% ink veil and a panel, and scroll is locked — a car runs in from off the left over 1.5s cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1) and stops at the left end of the button (go), idling with a 1px, .1° shake every .22s. Pressing the button makes the car accelerate over .7s cubic-bezier(.55,0,1,.45) off to the right (+300px) and leave, and 1s after the press the veil fades over .55s and the panel over .35s, sliding down 12px and scaling to .985 as they lift. Once lifted it fires fx:gate-open. At 666px and below the car only idles in place and then leaves.

options.in · out: Duration (s) of the transition in and out, default 1.5 · .7 — 0 for instant
options.narrow: At or below this width (px), idles in place with no entry path, default 666
options.[data-fx-part=card · car · lane · go]: Board · vehicle · band where the vehicle stops (aligned to center height) · button to press (required)
options.fx:gate-open: Event fired from the element after it clears — start Hero effects like the glitch or the hand appearing here
options.hold: Seconds until the curtain starts to lift after pressing, default 1 — in the original the car leaves at .7s and the curtain lifts on a 1s contrast timer (checked with motion-probe)

note: The original shows the curtain only on a first visit (not shown on a revisit within 3 days). Whether to show it is decided by the consumer. Since it makes people wait, the length is exposed as an option

from.where: index.html .sw-gate — entry veil and taxi for ”Join the Secret Mission”
